component: ICS and cached Calendar write completion

quotes.text: await adoptCallback(item.calendar, Cr.NS_OK, Ci.calIOperationListener.ADD, item.id, item);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: ICS adoptItem and modifyItem await their optional cached-calendar callback before endBatch runs in finally. The actual cache callback awaits its local write. The original refill loop also awaits each cache addition before ending its batch; accepted later code awaits allSettled additions and logs individual rejection instead. Keep those phases and error boundaries separate. This establishes source ordering, not transaction atomicity or complete failure/cancellation settlement.
title: Calendar batch completion includes awaited cache writes and cache callbacks
